list.title: Email campaigns
list.description: Bulk email campaigns — separate from the system's automated emails.
list.name: Name
list.empty: No campaigns yet. Click "+ New campaign" to get started.

builder.coming_soon: The campaign builder is coming soon.
builder.description: Content, recipients, review and send schedule — in order.

content.title: Email content
content.subject: Subject
content.markup_hint: Supported: blank line = new paragraph, "## Heading" for a heading, "- " for a list, **bold**.
content.preview_note: How {{name}} will see it — with the real greeting and the unsubscribe footer.

import.title: Import a list from Excel
import.description: Choose an .xlsx or .csv file. You'll see the first 10 rows before committing to anything.
import.parse_empty: No rows with a name, email or phone were found in this file.
import.parse_error: Reading the file failed. Check that it's a valid .xlsx or .csv.
import.dropped_warning_body: {{dropped}} rows were ignored — only the first {{limit}} were imported. Split the file into more parts and import the rest separately, or the campaign will only reach part of your list.

error_codes.permission_denied: You don't have permission for this action.
error_codes.invalid_state: The campaign is no longer in draft.

review.title: Recipient review
review.description: Work out who will receive this campaign before moving on to the send schedule.
review.no_numbers_yet: Recipients haven't been calculated for this campaign yet.

build_errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to calculate recipients.
build_errors.not_draft: Calculating recipients is only available while the campaign is a draft.

reasons.suppressed_list: Already bounced/complained, or asked to unsubscribe
reasons.internal: Internal email address (not a real recipient)

test_send.title: Test email
test_send.to_label: Will be sent to {{to}}, with the current content.
test_send.no_email: Couldn't find the signed-in user's email.
test_send.success: The test email was sent to {{to}}.
test_send.failed_identity_not_marketing: The campaign isn't set to the "marketing" identity — fix that before testing.
test_send.failed_unauthorized: You don't have permission to send a test email.
test_send.failed_unavailable: The test send isn't available right now. Try again later.

schedule.title: Send schedule
schedule.locked_notice: This campaign is now "{{status}}" — the pacing/schedule settings can no longer be edited.

estimate.stats_error: Couldn't load the recipient count — try refreshing the page.
estimate.no_recipients: Calculate recipients first, in the "Review" step, to see when sending would finish.
estimate.unavailable: The completion estimate can't be calculated.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: Launching starts actually emailing real people, following the schedule above.
launch.confirm_text: This will be sent to {{count}} people. It cannot be undone.
launch.count_unknown: The recipient count isn't known yet — launching is disabled until it loads.

errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to launch campaigns.
errors.invalid_state: The campaign isn't in draft or ready state — usually because a list was added or removed after the last recipient calculation. Recalculate recipients in the "Review" step and try again.
errors.not_prepared: You need to calculate recipients first, in the "Review" step.
errors.empty_subject: Add a subject to the email before launching, in the "Content" step.
errors.empty_body: Add body text to the email before launching, in the "Content" step.
errors.no_pending_recipients: There are no recipients to send to — recalculate recipients in the "Review" step.

autopause.title: Sending stopped automatically
autopause.body: The domain-reputation circuit breaker stopped this campaign: {{reason}}

controls.title: Send controls
controls.none_available: No actions are available for this status.
controls.pause_confirm_text: Sending will stop temporarily — you can resume it later.
controls.resume_confirm_text: Sending will start again from where it left off.
controls.cancel_confirm_text: This is final — a cancelled campaign cannot be resumed or restarted.

errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission for this action.
errors.invalid_state: This action is no longer available — the campaign's status changed. Refresh the page.
